name: auth0
description: Integrate and operate Auth0: app quickstarts, Actions, custom claims, and tenant management.

interface.shortDescription: Add Auth0 login to SPAs, web apps, and APIs; write Actions; manage tenants.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to the official Auth0 MCP server (@auth0/auth0-mcp-server) so you can manage applications, Actions, and logs on your own tenant with device-flow auth and read-only or scoped tool modes. The skills cover current SDK integration patterns for SPAs (auth0-react, auth0-spa-js), regular web apps (nextjs-auth0 v4, express-openid-connect), and APIs (express-oauth2-jwt-bearer), plus Actions with custom claims, rules migration, and tenant, application, and CLI setup.
defaultPrompt: Add Auth0 login to my Next.js app with the v4 SDK
Write a post-login Action that adds custom claims to my tokens
Audit my Auth0 tenant's applications and callback URLs
